title: Herbal Velvety Brazilian Chicken Dumplings
description: A Whole30-friendly Brazilian dish featuring herbal flavors and velvety texture, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. Made with sesame seed oil and wholesome ingredients.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine chicken, sesame seed oil, parsley, cilantro, garlic, and ginger. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together coconut flour, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Add the dry ingredients to the chicken mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat a large skillet with 1 tablespoon of sesame seed oil over medium heat.
Add 4-5 dumplings to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
